Topic: CUPED as y minus theta times centered pre-covariate
Story (story.md): Walk-through: difference between during-experiment and pre-experiment revenue is what's informative, baseline is noise.
Technical (chapter.md): Loop B Try: y_adj = y - theta*(x - x_mean), theta is single-covariate OLS slope; extends to vector theta with multiple pre-experiment covariates via y - X_centered @ theta.

Topic: Covariate must be measured pre-treatment

Technical (chapter.md): Loop B caveat: if the covariate is post-treatment, theta can absorb part of the effect and bias the adjusted outcome. Note that expkit.metrics.variance.cuped takes an arm argument but currently ignores it.
